contract_gaps.mutable_primary_url: Honeycomb publishes this official OpenAPI at a mutable documentation URL. Generation requires the exact pinned byte length and SHA-256 and fails closed on drift.
contract_gaps.regional_origin: The contract declares both US and EU API origins. Packs default to the US origin and use per_org enrollment so the connection owner can select the EU origin without exposing routing as an operation argument.
contract_gaps.batch_transport: POST /1/batch/{datasetSlug} also advertises application/octet-stream plus optional Content-Encoding. This pack admits the documented application/json array only and does not expose compression headers or binary upload.
contract_gaps.event_payloads: Single and batch event payloads are arbitrary JSON. They use literal body_raw strings so nested values and integer lexemes survive without schema narrowing or JavaScript number coercion.
contract_gaps.credential_separation: Configuration, Management bearer, ingest, and Firehose credentials are four separate connection vendors. The front door depends only on configuration-key leaves.
contract_gaps.api_key_secret: API key creation may return data.attributes.secret exactly once. The admin operation remains admitted and approval-gated, but no bundled workflow references or renders that field.
contract_gaps.source_absence: Query annotations are note-like, but the response schema does not require their stable id or timestamps. Markers have no read-by-id operation. Other entities do not truthfully project to task, note, or project. No Source is declared.

source_decision.reason: The official contract does not prove a mandatory stable remote identity and version for a buildable task, note, or project list/read pair.

candidates_rejected.reason: List and read operations exist, but id, created_at, and updated_at are read-only yet not required by the response schema, so identity and version presence are not contract-guaranteed.
Markers are note-like, but the contract has collection list plus create/update/delete and no GET-by-id read operation for source refresh.
These provider objects do not truthfully map to the supported task, note, or project work-entity categories.
